summary: Firefox now handles viewport sizing and scrolling more carefully, including when classic scrollbars or the software keyboard are present, and uses APZ (Async Pan/Zoom, Firefox’s responsive scrolling system) to frame small windows. The changes also improve anchor-positioned content and add zero-copy DMABuf video-frame sharing with remote Canvas2D on Linux, avoiding an extra copy of image data. Several related updates reduce unnecessary layout work and improve test coverage.
